answer: Alder blocks stack in the clogmaker's yard, pale and close-grained. zephyr splits the block and hollows it with the adze. Proof of clogmaker via carved clog tally — a clog the clogmaker carves only after 1063 clogs carve true without one sole splitting at the heel, each carved by the clogmaker himself. juniper shapes the toe and rounds the heel. sparrow smooths the sole and fits the leather upper. One thousand and sixty-three clogs must carve true without one sole splitting at the heel, and the next still splits where the wood ran knotty.
